<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under a fixed relational law and realization interpretation, joint realization within n steps after an actual prefix is reachable through the same intermediate configuration within prefix length plus n steps. The existing joint-activation law supplies changed one-step capacity after preparation, loss of joint realization at every finite horizon after release, and a path leaving available joint capacity unused. Unbounded backward reachability repeats the established inference and is not counted as another result.

Canonical source: [RelationalBecoming.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RelationalBecoming.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- One fixed process, stable endpoint meanings and an admitted finite prefix; all claims in a bundle share one history and endpoint.
- Event counts start at each current configuration and do not automatically represent physical duration; a common absolute deadline must count the preparation already spent.
- The application reuses JointContinuationClassification’s supplied coupling, event law and terminal configurations without claiming the coupling’s causal origin.
- Logic, representation and the existential interpretation remain explicit; no probability, optimal policy, infinite continuation or G0/J input is supplied.

Preparation, joint activation and release differentiate continuations within one activity. Trace concatenation retains the same intermediate configuration; history_meaning preserves the original realization semantics. The delta is a bounded refinement and application to an existing common activity. The prior possibility interface retains the ancestral-reachability/formed-condition/exercise distinction and its actual contact-formation evidence.
